name: CDEX
summary: CDEX uses low-threshold high-purity germanium at the China Jinping Underground Laboratory to search for light dark matter, while also studying axions, dark photons and other rare processes.
detection_principle: Point-contact germanium detectors reduce electronic noise through very low electrode capacitance and measure ionization from scattering or absorption. Anticoincidence and bulk/surface-event discrimination control low-energy backgrounds.

results.summary: CDEX-1 sets low-mass WIMP limits, testing interpretations of low-energy excesses in similar germanium experiments.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
